text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that teaches computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. Instead of just capturing a photo, a computer uses complex algorithms to recognize patterns, identify objects, and even interpret scenes. For example, image recognition can tell if a picture contains a cat, a car, or a person. Object detection goes further, locating exactly where each item is in an image. This technology has many practical applications. Social media uses it to tag friends in photos, and security systems use it to spot unusual activity. Perhaps the most exciting use is in self-driving cars, where computer vision helps vehicles detect pedestrians, traffic signs, and other cars to navigate safely. As the technology improves, its potential continues to grow in many areas of our daily lives.
